node.label: Israel-Palestine
node.summary: Gaza, the West Bank, UN findings and Israeli politics.

facts.text: Israel's 27 Oct election had the highest turnout since 1999 (**77.7%**); **Arab citizens** (about **20%** of the population) voted at nearly 80%. The **Joint List** (Balad, Hadash, Ta'al) and **Ra'am** (Mansour Abbas) won **19** seats, their best ever. Ra'am was the first Arab party in a government in nearly 44 years (**2021**, Bennett-Lapid).
facts.plain: Israel's 27 Oct election had the highest turnout since 1999 (77.7%); Arab citizens (about 20% of the population) voted at nearly 80%. The Joint List (Balad, Hadash, Ta'al) and Ra'am (Mansour Abbas) won 19 seats, their best ever. Ra'am was the first Arab party in a government in nearly 44 years (2021, Bennett-Lapid).

facts.text: Israel's final results: Netanyahu's bloc **53** of 120, Eisenkot's opposition **48**, Arab parties (Ra'am, Joint List) **19**; **Shin Bet** is probing alleged irregularities; results go to President **Isaac Herzog**.
facts.plain: Israel's final results: Netanyahu's bloc 53 of 120, Eisenkot's opposition 48, Arab parties (Ra'am, Joint List) 19; Shin Bet is probing alleged irregularities; results go to President Isaac Herzog.

facts.text: The **ICJ's July 2024 advisory opinion** held Israel's occupation of Palestinian territory unlawful and asked it to end as soon as possible; Justice Muralidhar urged states to comply.
facts.plain: The ICJ's July 2024 advisory opinion held Israel's occupation of Palestinian territory unlawful and asked it to end as soon as possible; Justice Muralidhar urged states to comply.

facts.text: UN Commission of Inquiry (chair **Justice S. Muralidhar**) told the UNGA that over **75,000** Palestinians (incl. 21,500 children) have been killed since **7 Oct 2023**, despite the **Oct 2025 ceasefire**; West Bank operations since Jan 2025 caused the largest displacement since 1967 (**34,176** still displaced). Israel's UN envoy **Danny Danon** rejected it.

facts.text: The Gaza war has killed over **70,000** Palestinians (per the analysis); Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving PM, faces an **ICC** arrest warrant.

facts.text: Israel's **27 Oct** election: Netanyahu's bloc **53**, Gadi Eisenkot's opposition **48**, Arab parties **19** (Joint List 12, Ra'am 7) — no side has **61**. Likud 27 (from 32), Yashar 21, B'Yachad (Naftali Bennett) 12, Yisrael Beytenu (Avigdor Lieberman) 7, Otzma Yehudit (Ben-Gvir) 7, Religious Zionism (Smotrich) 6. President: **Isaac Herzog**.
